name: sidekick
description: Checks your message before it is sent and offers a better way where there is one: a new chat with a handoff, a skill, a clearer version or a cheaper model. It never changes your words or sends anything without asking.

level.title: Level
level.description: off: nothing. cache: only the cold-cache question, no model calls. guide: all checks and hints. Also /sidekick off|cache|guide.

threshold.title: Check from (tokens)
threshold.description: From this context size every message gets a short check. Also /sidekick threshold 80k.

bigTokens.title: Cold-cache question from (tokens)
bigTokens.description: Asks before a cold send from this context size. Also /sidekick big 150k.

skills.title: Suggest skills
skills.description: Sends your skill list along with the check, so it can suggest one. Also /sidekick skills on|off.

maintenanceHints.title: Maintenance hints
maintenanceHints.description: Names due maintenance such as /skill-doctor or /init. Single rules: /sidekick hints. Also /sidekick hints on|off.

auditMin.title: Prompt audit from (tokens)
auditMin.description: Size of your instructions from which the audit hint appears. Also /sidekick hints audit-min 2k.

notes.title: Good to know
notes.description: While Claude works, a note when you likely missed something. Asks your main model every 6 steps. Also /sidekick notes on|off.

modelTip.title: Model tip
modelTip.description: On the first message on Opus or Fable, asks whether a cheaper model fits. Also /sidekick tips on|off.

modelTipAuto.title: Switch subagents automatically
modelTipAuto.description: Simple subagents and chats Claude starts run on a cheaper model. Also /sidekick tips auto on|off.

modelTipHaiku.title: Use Haiku for simple tasks
modelTipHaiku.description: Off: Sonnet is the cheapest target. Also /sidekick tips haiku on|off.

retryLoop.title: Retry loop
retryLoop.description: On the third correction in a row, offers a new chat or a step back. Also /sidekick loop on|off.

queue.title: Queue
queue.description: While Claude works, a message that is clearly a later item still goes straight in, with a note to Claude to finish the running task first. Also /sidekick queue on|off.

catalog.title: Skill catalog
catalog.description: When a message fits a skill from sidekick's small list of third-party skills, suggests it once per chat before sending. Installs nothing. Also /sidekick catalog on|off.

language.title: Language / Sprache
language.description: Language of the mod's texts and of its model prompts. en: English, de: Deutsch. Also /sidekick language.
